name: shake
description: Shrink a long session by replacing old tool results in the session file with saved-file placeholders, then reloading it

thresholdTokens.title: Shake threshold (tokens)
thresholdTokens.description: Used context, in tokens, at which a shake starts after an answer.

floorShare.title: Floor share
floorShare.description: Least share of the used context that a threshold shake must free. A shake rewrites the prompt cache of what stays, so a small shake costs more than it saves.

idleShake.title: Idle shake
idleShake.description: Shake with no floor when the prompt cache expires, also at once on a resume after a longer pause. The next request writes the whole cache in any case, so this shake costs nothing extra.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: 0 reads it from the session's newest cache write (60 or 5). Set a number only to override.
